# MiniCluster manifest for a LAMMPS ReaxFF experiment on a single AWS ARM-based CPU node.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Using an incrementing name to avoid collisions on subsequent runs.
  name: lammps-reax-mc-1
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods to schedule for the MiniCluster (equivalent to nodes).
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. This will run on the single node requested.
  tasks: 4

  # Logging mode set to strict as required.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Ensure the job resources are not deleted after completion to allow for inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Define the main application container.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to be executed by flux. Flux will prepend `flux run -n <tasks> ...`
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # This container is not the launcher; Flux Operator handles the launch logic.
      launcher: false

      # Always pull the image to ensure the latest version is used.
      imagePullPolicy: Always

      # Resource requests and limits for AWS Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) for HPC networking.
      resources:
        limits:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1
        requests:
          vpc.amazonaws.com/efa: 1

  # Flux-specific settings for the broker.
  flux:
    # Specify the architecture for the Flux broker since we are on ARM instances.
    arch: "arm"

    container:
      # Use an ARM-compatible image for the Flux view.
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-ubuntu:arm-jammy
      # As per instructions, the Flux sidecar container is disabled. The main container is Flux-aware.
      disable: true
